name: Beggar
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Pay 3¢: Roll- 3-4: Gain 2¢ 5: Loot 2. 6: Gain +1 treasure. Put this into discard.

name: Black Market
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Pay 2 HP: Steal an item from the shop.

name: Blind Rage
subtitle: Room Card
body: The active player must attack the monster deck once each turn if able.

name: Bomb Bum
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Discard a loot card: Roll. If the discarded card had “bomb” in its name, roll 3x instead --- 1-4: Deal 1 damage to a monster or player. 5-6: Take 1 damage.

name: Challenge Room
subtitle: Room Card
body: Each time a monster dies, the active player rolls- 4-6: They must make an additional attack this turn.

name: Daily Run
subtitle: Room Card
body:
Indomitable
This room can be attacked. Each time this takes damage, gain 4¢ or loot 1, then you may cancel your attack on this.

name: Devil Beggar
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Pay 1 HP: Roll- 1-2: Loot 2. 3-4: Loot 1. 5-6: Take 1 damage.

name: Dice Room I
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, the active player rerolls each item they control. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Dice Room II
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, each player discards their hands and loots 3. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Dice Room III
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, put each shop item into discard. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Dice Room IV
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, each player rerolls each of their items. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Dice Room V
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, put each monster into discard. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Dice Room VI
subtitle: Room Card
body: When this enters play, reroll each item in play, each player discards their hand and loots 3. Put each monster into discard. At the end of the turn, put this into discard.

name: Eden's Blessing
subtitle: Room Card
body: At the start of the turn, the active player may reroll an item they control.

name: Equality
subtitle: Room Card
body: If the player would gain any amount of ¢, instead each player gains that much ¢.

name: Eternal Chest
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Discard a loot card: Roll- 3: Gain 4¢. 4-5: Gain 7¢. 6: Gain +1 treasure and loot 1.

name: Fortune Teller
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Pay 3¢: roll- 3: Loot 1. 4: Loot 2. 5: Loot 3. 6: Loot 6. Put this into discard.

name: Greed Mode
subtitle: Room Card
body: Each time a monster dies, the active player gains ¢ equal to its HP. Each Tap ability on an item or character becomes a ¢ ability with “Pay 3¢”.

name: I Am Error
subtitle: Room Card
body: At the start of your turn roll- 1-2: Put a monster into discard and replace it with the top card of the monster deck 3-4: Reroll an item you control. 5: Discard your hand and loot 3. 6: Do all of the above.

name: Key Master
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Discard a loot card: Roll. If the discarded card had “key” in its name, roll 3x instead --- 5-6: Gain +1 treasure.

name: Planetarium
subtitle: Room Card
body: At the start of the turn, the active player may gain +1 treasure.

name: Restock Machine
subtitle: Room Card
body: ¢ Pay 2¢: Put each shop item or each monster not being attacked into discard.
